help.intro: This page explains how to use every MD2Tool converter. If this is your first visit, start with the quick tutorial below; for specific issues, check the FAQ.

tutorial.title: Quick Start
tutorial.intro: Four steps to convert a document — the flow is the same for every tool:

steps.title: Pick a converter
steps.content: On the home page, click the card for the conversion you need (e.g. "Word to Markdown"). MD2Tool converts between Markdown and Word, HTML, PDF, and Excel — everything runs locally in your browser.

steps.title: Enter your content
steps.content: Text-based tools (Markdown/HTML related) take pasted or typed input in the editor on the left; file-based tools (Word to Markdown) work by clicking the upload button or dropping in a .docx file. The supported format is .docx (for legacy .doc files, save as .docx in Word first).

steps.title: Check the live preview
steps.content: The right side shows the converted result in real time. Markdown tools keep the editor and preview scroll-synced for easy comparison. If something looks off, go back to the left and edit the source.

steps.title: Export or copy the result
steps.content: When everything looks right, click Convert or Download to export the file (DOCX / HTML / PDF / XLSX). Text results can also be copied to the clipboard with the Copy button. No registration, no usage limits.

items.q: Do I need to register or pay to use MD2Tool?
items.a: No. MD2Tool is completely free — no registration or login, and no usage limits. Just open the page and start converting.

items.q: Are my files uploaded to a server?
items.a: No. All conversions run locally in your browser. File contents are never uploaded or stored, and temporary data is cleared when you close the page.

items.q: Are formulas and images preserved when converting Word to Markdown?
items.a: LaTeX formulas are converted into Markdown LaTeX syntax ($...$ / $$...$$). Image extraction is not supported yet, so the converted output does not include images — add them manually afterwards if needed.

items.q: Why can't I upload a .doc Word file?
items.a: Only .docx (Office 2007 and later) is supported. For legacy .doc files, open them in Word or WPS first, choose Save As, and save them as .docx before uploading.

items.q: Why do code blocks turn into images in the PDF?
items.a: To keep code blocks intact and prevent them from being split across pages, longer code blocks are rendered as images. This is expected behavior and does not affect the content.

items.q: Does Markdown to Excel have requirements for table syntax?
items.a: Use standard Markdown table syntax (a | --- | row separates the header from the body). Each table is exported to its own location in the Excel file; documents without tables produce no usable output.

items.q: The result looks garbled or wrongly formatted. What can I do?
items.a: First make sure the source content is complete and well-formed; you can also try converting smaller chunks. If the problem persists, reach out via the Contact page with a snippet of the problematic content and we will fix it as soon as possible.
Standard Markdown syntax plus common extensions: tables, code blocks (with syntax highlighting), LaTeX math formulas, Mermaid diagrams, and task lists.

intro.p1: MD2Tool is a completely free, open-source online document converter focused on conversions between Markdown and other document formats. We aim to give developers and content creators a simple, fast, and secure conversion service.
intro.p2: Every conversion runs locally in your browser — we never collect, store, or upload your file contents, keeping your privacy and data safe.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.p1: MD2Tool ("we", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and manage your personal information.
intro.p2: By using this website you agree to the terms of this privacy policy. If you do not agree with it, please do not use this website.

weCollect.label: Usage data:
weCollect.text: We may collect information about how you use the website, including pages visited, visit times, and time spent.

weCollect.label: Device information:
weCollect.text: We may collect information about your device type, browser type, operating system, and similar details.

weCollect.label: Cookies:
weCollect.text: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve user experience and analyze website traffic.

weDont.label: Uploaded file contents:
weDont.text: We promise never to collect, store, or transmit the contents of any file you upload for conversion. All file conversion happens locally in your browser.

weDont.label: Personal identity information:
weDont.text: No account registration is required, and we do not collect names, emails, phone numbers, or other personal identity information.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.p: We use the following types of cookies:

items.label: Essential cookies:
items.text: cookies required for the website to function properly.

items.label: Analytics cookies:
items.text: used to analyze website usage and improve user experience.

items.label: Advertising cookies:
items.text: used to show personalized ads (see the "Advertising Services" section below).

cookies.p2: You can manage cookie preferences in your browser settings. Note that disabling some cookies may affect website functionality.

security.title: Data Security
security.p: We take appropriate security measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure. However, no internet transmission is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee the security of information in transit.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.p: This website is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.
